claims.text: An unordered text document is one where the sentences are not arranged in a specific order, and it can be structured into sections based on keywords.
Unordered text documents arise in real-world corpora, as they are processed in applications like multiple document summarization and question answering.
The process of structuring unordered documents is essential for improving coherence and flow in text processing applications.
